what: A ‹[:: Click to Enter ::]› tag waits at the screen center, then from the first mouse move follows to the cursor position (10px above, centered) .66s (power1.out) late. Clicking anywhere makes the tag drop 40px and vanish with .66s back.in(2) and fires fx:enter (entry — hook sound on and scene opening here)

options.drop: Distance moved down while fading (px), default 40
options.wait: If ready, clicking does not enter until fx:ready arrives on the document (only after the scene is fully loaded)

use: [:: Click to enter + sound on ::]
note: Same entry prompt as enter-disc-cursor (170px circle·difference·appears after 2 seconds) but the type and phone behavior differ, so it is kept separate — this one floats at center from the start and stays in place on phone, entering on tap. The disc is fixed to the screen and does not intercept presses (pointer-events: none)

from.where: index.html ”CLICK TO ENTER + ENABLE AUDIO” (original Enter script — gsap.to .66, exit .66 back.in(2) y 40)
